# Author / evaluator only

Do not disclose this directory to the solver before a frozen candidate is received.
Oracle arithmetic is derived from original design parameters in create_cases.py, not QTO outputs.
The only public deliverable is ../inputs. Use the current release manifest to verify unchanged inputs.
Candidate scoring must align physical extents after freeze, respecting legitimate primitive splits.
Count missing/doubled physical work, wrong DN/material and unsupported rule interpretation separately from arithmetic.
No existing benchmark answer, production script output or prior project input was used as an oracle.
